content.title: Daredevil: Born Again Season 2: Now Streaming, Trailer & Plot | Explore Disney+
content.text: The Devil of Hell’s Kitchen battles Mayor Fisk for the soul of New York City in a new season of the Marvel Television show, now streaming on Disney+Wilson Fisk is calling the shots as Mayor of New York, but Matt Murdock refuses to play along with Fisk’s new rules. Eight episodes. Bigger stakes. And a season that’s not pulling any punches. Watch the trailer below, then read on to find out how to stream season 2.0:35Daredevil: Born Again Season 2 Is Now Streaming: Here Are The Answers To Your Biggest QuestionsDaredevil: Born Again, Marvel Television, Disney+When does Daredevil: Born Again Season 2 come out?Season 2 premiered on March 24, 2026, with episodes now streaming exclusively on Disney+.Add Daredevil: Born Again to WatchlistWhat is Daredevil: Born Again Season 2 about?Mayor Wilson Fisk crushes New York City underfoot as he hunts down public enemy number one, the Hell’s Kitchen vigilante known as Daredevil. But beneath the horned mask, Matt Murdock will try to fight back from the shadows to tear down the Kingpin’s corrupt empire and redeem his home. Is Jessica Jones in Daredevil: Born Again Season 2?Yes! Krysten Ritter is reprising her role as fan-favorite private investigator and Super Hero, Jessica Jones.Where can you watch Daredevil: Born Again Season 2?Season 2 will stream exclusively on Disney+.How many episodes are in Daredevil: Born Again Season 2?Season 2 spans eight episodes, with new installments releasing weekly after the March 24 premiere.Who’s behind Daredevil: Born Again Season 2?Daredevil: Born Again, Marvel Television, Disney+Season 2 comes from Marvel Television, created by Dario Scardapane, Chris Ord, and Matt Corman, with Scardapane serving as executive producer and showrunner for the series.Cast & Characters Of Daredevil: Born Again Season 2For a list of returning and new faces, head to our Daredevil: Born Again cast and character guide here on Explore Disney+.Daredevil: Born Again Season 2 Has A Companion Podcast Daredevil: Born Again gets a companion video podcast that delves deeper into the show’s second season. Expect guests from the cast, including Charlie Cox, Michael Gandolfini, Margarita Levieva, Vincent D’Onofrio, and more. The podcast unpacks each episode as it airs, giving you behind-the-scenes access, new perspectives, and offering a helping hand in unpacking all the season’s layers.The companion podcast streams on Disney+, with new episodes releasing weekly alongside the show.Add Daredevil: Born Again Official Podcast to WatchlistWhat Happened In The First Season Of Daredevil: Born AgainDaredevil: Born Again, Marvel Television, Disney+In Season 1, Matt Murdock, motivated to leave behind the mask, fights for justice as a lawyer while Wilson Fisk pursues power in New York. As their past identities resurface, the two are pulled toward an inevitable showdown. If you want to go deeper into Season 1 before streaming Season 2, Watch Charlie Cox, Vincent D’Onofrio, and Brad Winderbaum discuss Daredevil: Born Again.Add Daredevil: Born Again to Watchlist to catch up or rewatch Season 1.
